# uptimeeye_status_page_domain (Resource)

A custom domain attached to a status page. The API has no update operation for domains, so every configuration change replaces the domain. `status` and `last_error` reflect the server-side DNS/TLS provisioning state and change over time. Import with `<status_page_id>/<domain_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeeye_status_page_domain" "status" {
  status_page_id = uptimeeye_status_page.public.id
  hostname       = "status.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Fully qualified hostname (e.g. `status.example.com`). Changing this forces a new domain.
- `status_page_id` (String) Id of the status page the domain belongs to. Changing this forces a new domain.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain identifier.
- `last_error` (String) Last provisioning error, if any (server-managed).
- `status` (String) DNS/provisioning state of the domain (server-managed, changes over time).
